description: This file defines constants used for JWT (JSON Web Token) testing, including pre-generated tokens, RSA key pairs, issuer information, and methods for creating JWTs.

classes.name: JwtTestConstants
classes.description: A final class containing static constants and methods for JWT test tokens, key management, and JWT creation logic.

methods.name: createJwt
methods.description: Creates a valid JWT token signed with the private key, with header and issuer claims.

methods.name: createExpiredJwt
methods.description: Creates an expired JWT token signed with the private key, with header, issuer, and expiration claims.
